method.percentile: nearest-rank: sort the n values, take the value at rank ceil(p/100 * n) (1-based); no interpolation, so every percentile is an observed wait
method.burst: queue at t = jobs with submitted_at <= t < started_at (half-open); burst_queue: the queue every 15 min from the window start to 2 h after its end; burst_peak_queue: the largest queue at any instant in the window, first reached burst_peak_after_s after its start; burst_recovery_s: when the last job submitted in the window started, minus the window end (negative: before the window ended; null: no job submitted in it)
method.money: integer micro-dollars (1 USD = 1_000_000); dollars only in the markdown
method.idle_share: team: idle / team total; overall: teams' idle / grand total (provider overhead, i.e. never-ready nodes, is reported separately)
method.across_seeds: median = lower median (an observed value), with min and max
method.seeds: boot times and failure draws are keyed by node launch number, which differs between policies; a policy difference counts only if it holds in every seed
method.replay_rule: every job runs actual_minutes after it starts, then ends with the row's outcome; a cancel means cancelled after actual_minutes of runtime
